title: Filmora Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs, and What You Get
summary: Filmora pricing structures vary significantly based on whether you are editing personal videos, commercial content, or managing a collaborative team.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


A clean test export proves the pipeline works, but not that the licence behind it covers the client it serves.


Some answers below were checked against Filmora's own pages on 13 November 2026, though several figures could not be verified, so check the linked page before you pay.


Is Filmora really free to use? Yes for trying it, no for delivering work. The free version lets you edit and export, but exports carry a watermark, so nothing you hand to a client should come from it.


Does the one-time Filmora licence include AI features? Don't assume so. The perpetual licence covers the editor itself, while AI tools run on credits or cloud processing that Filmora treats separately.


If a client's brief leans on AI, price those credits as a recurring line on your side. Check Filmora's pricing page for what each licence type includes.


### Can I use Filmora videos on a monetized channel?


On a paid licence, Filmora's own pages do not state commercial-use terms, so confirm the license details before using it on any client-facing job. The free watermarked version isn't the one to monetize.


Stock media and AI-generated assets inside the editor may carry their own terms, so read Filmora's licence agreement and its commercial-use page before you pass work to a client.


### How do I cancel a Filmora subscription?


Cancel from your Wondershare account's subscription or order management area, before the renewal date, so you aren't billed for another term. If a shared login's paying for several clients, cancel on the account that holds the billing, and check whose card's on it.


Filmora's refund policy page sets the conditions for money back, and the window and eligibility rules differ by plan, so read it on the day you buy.


Is there a student discount for Filmora? Filmora has run an education offer that requires you to verify student or teacher status.


Because it's a discount on a plan rather than a separate licence, confirm on Filmora's education page that it covers commercial use, since a discounted seat used for paid client work may fall outside it.
